articles.summary: Amazon Music Presents: Parker McCollum Honoring Veterans Day, Live from Texas, a special concert by multi-platinum country music star and recent ACM Album of the Year winner Parker McCollum. Created together with Under Armour’s UA Freedom platform, the performance will take place on November 10 in Austin, TX in front of a hometown crowd of active military members and veterans, their families and UA Freedom guests.
articles.title: Amazon Music Presents: Parker McCollum Honoring Veterans Day, Live from Texas, Sponsored by UA Freedom

articles.summary: UA Tech Helix, Under Armour's new performance tee built to create space between fabric and skin when the work heats up. At its core is a unique, coil-shaped fiber construction that creates fresh airflow to help eliminate that sticky, sweaty feeling, giving athletes one less distraction and greater freedom to focus on performing at their best.
articles.title: What If Your Training Tee Could Lift Off Your Skin?
